description: The grouped bar chart illustrates, for four question-answering datasets, the number of questions (out of 40) whose chain-of-thought outputs contain at least one factual error under three different methods (as indicated by the legend). The horizontal axis lists the datasets as categorical labels—HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC—from left to right, with no additional scale type beyond categorical ordering. The vertical axis is a linear numeric scale ranging from 0 to 40 (count of questions), with regularly spaced tick marks at 5-unit intervals. Each dataset has three adjacent bars corresponding to the methods: NoR QA (orange bar with a light grid/hatch pattern), OneR QA (red bar with a dotted pattern), and IRCot QA (dark blue bar with diagonal stripe hatching), with numeric value labels printed above each bar. For HotpotQA, the bars read approximately 15 (NoR QA), 10 (OneR QA), and 5 (IRCot QA). For 2WikiMQA, the values are about 29 (NoR QA), 23 (OneR QA), and 14 (IRCot QA). For MuSiQue, the values are about 28 (NoR QA), 27 (OneR QA), and 23 (IRCot QA). For IIRC, the values are about 15 (NoR QA), 14 (OneR QA), and 11 (IRCot QA). The bars are arranged in consistent left-to-right method order within each dataset group (orange, then red, then blue), and there is no visible sorting of the dataset categories by bar height; no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the displayed value annotations.
